name: Kabuki Chopper
source:
A streamer notorious for pushing the envelope with outrageous content carved a lucrative niche (3M+ subscribers) by turning Kabuki-cho, a notorious den of iniquity, into his personal comedic playground. Rumors swirl of his annual income hitting the stratosphere—millions, if not tens of millions, of yen.

Lately, he's been thumbing his nose at the yakuza by exploiting stricter Anti-Violence Law enforcement, staging elaborate pranks on unsuspecting gangsters. One particularly brazen stunt, captured in the viral video "Tattooing Yakuza Car, lol," saw him tag Tougi's (a known yakuza figure) Bentley with a fluorescent marker, garnering 500k+ views.

[Translated from the [url=http://clockup.net/yrg/#character]official website[/url]]
